thread:
clara: SRE flagged a UX gap: console rows show 'fallback' but no way to quickly jump to which rollout policy or trigger produced it. Takes too long in incidents.

jason: saw that too during the outage. We ended up grepping for 3 different ids. Not great.

meena: idea: emit a tiny stable token (fbid) that appears in console row, telemetry, and optionally a response header for internal debugging. Token = rid:<short-hash>. Keep it intentionally short to fit in logs.

hao: if we do header, call it X-Rd-FB so it's less likely to collide with customer headers. Header should be small kv pairs: id=rid...;t=OOM;from=XL;to=SM. Opt-in flag for orgs and internal keys only. No prompt or user content in headers.

jason: Agree on opt-in. For UI, show a compact badge in the row with the token and a chevron. Clicking opens an "audit drawer" with links: open eventstore (pre-filtered), operator overrides, and an export button. Keep default row height unchanged.

infra-bot: :information_source: feature-flag plan: "rw.fallback.audit_header" -> staging rollout 2026-04-02. Full event payload always sent to event-store.

meena: Implementation note: deterministic id generation in runtime is critical. Suggest id = base36(sha1(request_id || policy_v || floor(ts/60)))[:10] to be stable across retries within the same minute.

clara: UX asks: drawer should show trigger_type (TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMIT, MODEL_OOM, MODEL_ERROR), parent_fbid for chained fallbacks, model artifact digest, and a small diff of route config that changed during rollout.

hao: add operator metadata when an operator overrides (who, reason, ttl). Show it collapsed but searchable in drawer. Also provide CSV export of the timeline for audits.

jason: telemetry: emit metrics counters.fallbacks_by_trigger and a tag fallback.id for trace correlation. Eventstore entries must include policy_name and policy_version to make rollups easy.

meena: sample header example for RFC: X-Rd-FB: id=rid:ab12cd34;t=TIMEOUT;pf=soft-fail:v2;to=redwood-small. We'll compress and cap length to ~120 chars.

clara: tests: unit for id-gen, e2e asserting header present when flag ON and absent for public keys, and UI integration tests for drawer + CSV export. Perf: measure header overhead at 5k rps.

hao: small ops ask: include a direct "inspect" CLI: rw-fallback inspect <rid> that opens eventstore summary. Useful for on-call.

jason: privacy reminder: headers must never contain prompt text or customer content. Telemetry can include a sanitized "reason_text" but only in eventstore with RBAC.

meena: I'll write a short RFC with schema, header examples, and the drawer mockup. Will ping @eng-sre and @eng-ml for model-switch hooks.

clara: thanks team. If we can get the token wired into staging this week, SRE can validate during the next chaos run.

infra-bot: :rocket: RFC draft scheduled for 2026-03-29.
